name: Demonstration Designer help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Demonstration Designer: the page, its three picks and Generate, the pitch actions, the Advanced timeline and recorder, and every setting.
author: Brett

entries.title: Demonstration Designer
entries.text: Pitch the product in three picks and one button: what to show, how long, which voice. Generate writes the script with zero tokens and plays it on the console's real screens with highlights, zooms, captions, music and a logo intro and outro.

entries.title: What to show
entries.text: Type the name of a plugin, screen or UI element. Everything the console registers is here; pick one row and the pitch is written about it.

entries.title: Kind of thing to show
entries.text: Narrow the list to plugins, screens or other UI elements.

entries.title: Change
entries.text: Drop the picked topic and search for another.

entries.title: Length in minutes
entries.text: How long the pitch should run. The script is fitted to it: too many words and the weakest beats go, too few and each screen is shown a little longer.

entries.title: Voice
entries.text: The narrator: a voice this device has, the default one, or captions only without speech.

entries.title: Pace
entries.text: How fast the narrator speaks: calm, normal or brisk.

entries.title: Generate
entries.text: Writes the pitch (a hook, the best screens with highlighted controls, a call to action), saves it and plays it at once. No model, no tokens.

entries.title: Play
entries.text: Plays the pitch on the live console: the stage covers the screen, the console moves to each screen, the spotlight lands on each control, the narrator reads the words. Space pauses, arrows step, Escape stops.

entries.title: Stop
entries.text: Ends the pitch and puts the console back the way it was.

entries.title: Export video
entries.text: Plays the pitch while recording this tab (the browser asks which tab once). The recording is kept as a clip and offered for download; the server makes an MP4 when it has ffmpeg.

entries.title: Copy share link
entries.text: Copies a link that opens the console on this pitch; add &axf-autoplay=1 to have it play at once.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Removes the saved pitch. Its recordings stay as clips.

entries.title: Script
entries.text: The words of the pitch, one block per step: a # Title line, then what the narrator says. Edit freely; the actions and highlights stay with their step.

entries.title: Apply script
entries.text: Saves the edited words into the pitch's steps.

entries.title: Reset words
entries.text: Puts the script box back to the saved words.

entries.title: Add to the tour
entries.text: Pick another saved pitch to play after this one; chained pitches make a longer tour.

entries.title: Add to tour
entries.text: Chains the picked pitch after this one.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reloads the list of saved pitches.

entries.title: Advanced
entries.text: The folded part: a step-by-step timeline of the pitch and record by doing. The main flow never needs it.

entries.title: Start recording
entries.text: From now on every screen you open and every control you tap in the console is noted; stop when you have shown what you want.

entries.title: Stop recording
entries.text: Ends the record-by-doing session; the moves wait to be turned into steps.

entries.title: Add steps to this pitch
entries.text: Turns the recorded moves into steps with draft words and adds them to the open pitch.

entries.title: Make a pitch from it
entries.text: Turns the recorded moves into a new saved pitch with draft words you can tweak.

entries.title: Add step
entries.text: Adds an empty step at the end of the timeline.

entries.title: Save timeline
entries.text: Saves the edited steps (words, actions, targets, highlights, dwell) into the pitch.

entries.title: Revert
entries.text: Drops the timeline edits and shows the saved steps again.

entries.title: Play this step
entries.text: Plays the pitch from this step, without the logo cards.

entries.title: Up
entries.text: Moves this step one place earlier.

entries.title: Down
entries.text: Moves this step one place later.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Takes this step out of the timeline.

entries.title: Title
entries.text: The step's name, shown above the caption: Hook, a screen, a control, the call to action.

entries.title: Say
entries.text: What the narrator says on this step.

entries.title: Do
entries.text: The console action the step runs first, such as nav:builds or settings.open:plugins. Never a URL.

entries.title: Target
entries.text: What the spotlight lands on: text=Label for a control by its words, or a CSS selector.

entries.title: Highlight label
entries.text: The small label drawn over the spotlight.

entries.title: Dwell (ms)
entries.text: Time the screen is shown before the words start.

entries.title: Demonstration Designer settings
entries.text: Everything about how a pitch is written and played: script, narration, stage, music, export and the Advanced section. The same values are on REST, MCP and the CLI.

entries.title: Default length
entries.text: The minutes the page starts on; any pitch can pick another.

entries.title: Benefits first
entries.text: Sentences that sell (you, one place, never, without…) are spoken before the ones that merely describe.

entries.title: Product name
entries.text: Shown on the logo intro and outro cards.

entries.title: Call to action
entries.text: The closing line of every generated pitch.

entries.title: Narrator pace (words per minute)
entries.text: How many words a minute the narrator is assumed to speak when a script is fitted to its length. Default 150.

entries.title: Save script settings
entries.text: Saves the product name, call to action and pace.

entries.title: Default narrator
entries.text: The voice new pitches use: a device voice, the default one, or captions only.

entries.title: Speed
entries.text: How fast the default narrator speaks.

entries.title: Captions
entries.text: Show the words at the bottom of the stage while they are spoken.

entries.title: Caption size
entries.text: Small, medium or large captions.

entries.title: Zoom and pan
entries.text: The app zooms in on each highlighted control and glides back for whole screens.

entries.title: Most zoom
entries.text: How far in the stage may zoom, as a percentage of the normal size.

entries.title: Highlight
entries.text: Spotlight dims everything but the control; Outline only draws a frame around it.

entries.title: Player controls on the stage
entries.text: Show Pause, Back, Next and Stop on the stage. Keyboard and voice work either way.

entries.title: Logo intro
entries.text: Open every pitch with the product mark and its title.

entries.title: Logo outro
entries.text: Close every pitch with the product mark and the call to action.

entries.title: Logo card seconds
entries.text: How long each logo card stays.

entries.title: Background music
entries.text: Soft chords synthesised in the browser under the narration; nothing to download.

entries.title: Music volume
entries.text: How loud the music is; it ducks while the narrator speaks.

entries.title: Mood
entries.text: Calm, upbeat or minimal chords.

entries.title: Recording format
entries.text: What the browser is asked to record: MP4 where it can, else WebM.

entries.title: Make an MP4 on the server
entries.text: After an upload the server transcodes WebM to MP4 with ffmpeg when it has one.

entries.title: Recordings to keep
entries.text: Older recordings and their clips are removed after each upload.

entries.title: Save export settings
entries.text: Saves how many recordings to keep.

entries.title: Show the Advanced section on the page
entries.text: Folds the timeline and record-by-doing tools in or out of the designer page.

entries.title: Pause
entries.text: Pauses the pitch where it is; Resume carries on.

entries.title: Back
entries.text: Goes back one step of the pitch.

entries.title: Next
entries.text: Skips to the next step of the pitch.

entries.title: Open the Demonstration Designer on a pitch
entries.text: Opens the designer with the given pitch selected.

entries.title: Play a pitch demo
entries.text: Plays a saved pitch on the live console by its id.

entries.title: Export a pitch demo as video
entries.text: Plays the pitch while recording it; the file is kept as a clip.

entries.title: Generate a pitch
entries.text: Writes and plays a pitch of a plugin or screen, with the minutes given.

entries.title: Pitch: pause
entries.text: Pauses the running pitch.

entries.title: Pitch: resume
entries.text: Carries on with a paused pitch.

entries.title: Pitch: next step
entries.text: Skips to the next step.

entries.title: Pitch: previous step
entries.text: Goes back one step.

entries.title: Pitch: stop
entries.text: Ends the running pitch.

entries.title: Demonstration Designer
entries.text: Opens the Demonstration Designer page.

steps.say: Three picks make a pitch: what to show, how long, and which voice.
Generate writes the script with zero tokens and plays it on the real console at once.
Afterwards tweak the words, export the video or copy a share link. Advanced tools stay folded at the bottom.
